```python
import narwhals as nw

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David"],
    "spend": [1500, 800, 1000, 500]
}
df = nw.from_dict(data)

# Add tier column using backend-evaluated conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
    .then(nw.lit("gold"))
    .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

print(df)
```
